description: TalosNode is one member of a TalosCluster: the machine-specific half of its configuration, and what the machine reports once it runs.

fields.name: spec
fields.description: TalosNodeSpec is what belongs to one machine. Its hostname is the object's metadata.name.

fields.name: address
fields.description: Address is where the operator and talosctl reach the node's Talos API. Empty means the first static address of the first link. A node that only takes DHCP addresses needs it set, or its check-in has nothing to dial.

fields.name: clusterRef
fields.description: ClusterRef names the TalosCluster this node is a member of.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the object.

fields.name: installDiskSelector
fields.description: InstallDiskSelector picks the disk Talos installs onto. That disk is repartitioned and everything on it is erased. A disk matches when every matcher you set holds; if several disks match, Talos takes the first one it finds, which can change between boots. Prefer serial or wwid, which name exactly one disk.

validations.message: at least one matcher is required: a node that does not say where to install does not install

fields.name: busPath
fields.description: BusPath matches the disk's bus path. It changes when a disk moves to another slot.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Match is a CEL expression over `disk` (Talos' disk locator environment), for example `disk.size > 100u * GB && !disk.rotational`.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Model matches the disk model. Machines often have several disks of the same model; combine it with another matcher.

fields.name: serial
fields.description: Serial matches the disk serial number. It names one disk and does not change when disks are re-cabled or found in another order.

fields.name: wwid
fields.description: WWID matches the disk's world wide identifier.

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Labels are Kubernetes node labels the kubelet registers with. Worker nodes may only set labels the NodeRestriction admission plugin allows.

fields.name: network
fields.description: Network configures the node's links.

fields.name: links
fields.description: Links configure physical links, each selected by its MAC address.

validations.message: a link without DHCP needs at least one static address

fields.name: addresses
fields.description: Addresses are static addresses in CIDR form, primary family first.

fields.name: dhcp
fields.description: DHCP runs a DHCPv4 client on the link, alongside any static addresses.

fields.name: hardwareAddr
fields.description: HardwareAddr is the link's permanent MAC address. A physical link whose driver reports no permanent address is matched on its current one instead. Lower case and colon-separated (0c:c4:7a:12:34:56): Talos compares it as text.

fields.name: mtu
fields.description: MTU overrides the link MTU.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name is the alias the link gets. Avoid kernel names (eth0, enp0s2): an alias must not collide with a real interface.

fields.name: routes
fields.description: Routes are static routes over this link.

fields.name: gateway
fields.description: Gateway is the next hop.

fields.name: metric
fields.description: Metric orders competing routes.

fields.name: network
fields.description: Network is the destination CIDR; empty is the default route.

fields.name: patches
fields.description: Patches apply to this node only, in order, after the cluster's patches.

validations.message: exactly one of inline or configMapRef

fields.name: configMapRef
fields.description: ConfigMapRef reads the patch from a ConfigMap key.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The key in the object's data.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the object.

fields.name: namespace
fields.description: The namespace of the object.

fields.name: inline
fields.description: Inline is the patch text.

fields.name: role
fields.description: Role is controlplane or worker.

fields.name: schematic
fields.description: Schematic customizes this node's installer image and replaces the cluster's schematic when set. Extensions and kernel arguments both live here: Talos takes the installed kernel command line from the image, so an argument that is not part of the schematic does not survive the install.

fields.name: customization
fields.description: SchematicCustomization holds the image customization knobs.

fields.name: extraKernelArgs
fields.description: ExtraKernelArgs append to the image's kernel command line, for example where to put the console (console=ttyS0, what the BMC's serial-over-LAN shows). Do not add talos.config=metal-iso: the operator adds it to the boot medium itself, and the installed system must not carry it.

fields.name: systemExtensions
fields.description: SystemExtensions bakes extensions into the image.

fields.name: officialExtensions
fields.description: OfficialExtensions are siderolabs/* extension names (siderolabs/drbd).

fields.name: taints
fields.description: Taints are Kubernetes node taints the kubelet registers with.

fields.name: effect
fields.description: TaintEffect is a Kubernetes taint effect.

fields.name: status
fields.description: TalosNodeStatus reports the render and the machine's check-in. Rendered=False is alert-and-hold: the last rendered Secret stays in place, so a broken input never un-renders a machine's config.

fields.name: address
fields.description: Address is where the check-in dials (spec.address, or the first static link address).

fields.name: appliedConfigDigest
fields.description: AppliedConfigDigest is the rendered config the machine was last seen to run: the digest of a render a dry run found no change against. Config Secrets of other digests are collected once nothing refers to them.

fields.name: conditions
fields.description: Conditions: Rendered, plus the check-in observations MachineReachable and Ready while a Host hands this node a machine, ConfigInSync (the dry-run drift check) and VersionCurrent (Talos version skew).

fields.name: lastTransitionTime
fields.description: The time of the last change of the status.

fields.name: message
fields.description: A message for people about the last change. It can be empty.

fields.name: observedGeneration
fields.description: The generation of the object that the condition is for. A lower value than metadata.generation shows an old condition.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: A word in CamelCase that tells why the condition has its status.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The status of the condition: True, False or Unknown.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The type of the condition.

fields.name: configDigest
fields.description: ConfigDigest is sha256:<hex> of the rendered config, what BootAsset builds key their rebuilds on.

fields.name: configSecretRef
fields.description: ConfigSecretRef points at the Secret holding this node's rendered machine config (key config.yaml). Owned by the TalosNode and collected with it; it is the one place the rendered secrets rest.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the object.

fields.name: namespace
fields.description: The namespace of the object.

fields.name: drift
fields.description: Drift is the last dry run of the rendered config against the machine (ConfigInSync tells the verdict).

fields.name: changed
fields.description: Changed: the machine runs a config that differs from this render.

fields.name: configDigest
fields.description: ConfigDigest is the rendered config the dry run was made with.

fields.name: observedAt
fields.description: ObservedAt is when the dry run was made.

fields.name: rebootRequired
fields.description: RebootRequired: the machine said it needs a reboot to take it.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: Summary counts the changed lines and names the configuration keys they touch. Values are left out: a diff of a machine config carries secrets.

fields.name: installerImage
fields.description: InstallerImage is the installer the rendered config installs from.

fields.name: renderedFor
fields.description: RenderedFor is the Talos version the config was rendered for: the cluster's talosVersion, or the older version the machine still runs until its upgrade, so that a config is never written for a contract the running machine does not accept yet.

fields.name: stage
fields.description: Stage is the machine's observed boot stage (maintenance, booting, installing, running, ...), empty while no machine answers.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Version is the Talos version the machine reports.
